resources.string: GameCube BIOS (IPL.bin) — optional. Pokémon XD runs fine without it. If you add one from your own GameCube, the GameCube startup animation plays before the game.
Choose your own Pokémon XD: Gale of Darkness disc image (.iso, .gcm, .rvz, .ciso, .gcz, .wbfs). Dolphin XD remembers it, so you only do this once.
Your Pokémon XD file can\'t be opened any more (moved, renamed or deleted?). Please choose it again.

Tap — A
Hold — B
Double-tap — Start
Tap, then tap and hold on the left half — L
Tap, then tap and hold on the right half — X
Swipe and keep your finger down — Control Stick, in any direction
Two-finger tap, then two-finger tap and hold — Dolphin menu

While one finger moves the stick, tap with another finger for A or hold it for B. Game controllers work too.
Dolphin couldn\'t read that file. Make sure it\'s a GameCube disc image of Pokémon XD: Gale of Darkness.
That file is %1$s (%2$s), not Pokémon XD: Gale of Darkness. Dolphin XD only plays Pokémon XD.
That doesn\'t look like a GameCube BIOS. A BIOS dump is a 2 MB file usually called IPL.bin.
Dolphin XD couldn\'t read that file.
Your BIOS is from a different region than your copy of Pokémon XD, so the GameCube startup animation is skipped.
The GameCube BIOS couldn\'t be installed, so the startup animation is skipped.
Pokémon XD is still closing. Press Play again in a moment.
This closes Pokémon XD so you can choose a different game file. Progress since your last in-game save will be lost.
Two-finger tap, then tap and hold, opens the Dolphin menu.
